subject: ModuWare x Redwood: Integration Showcase & Field Roundtable Series
messages:
From: Ananya Rao <ananya@moduware.io>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: James O'Connor <james@devsprint.co>
Date: Sun, 30 May 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Joint integration showcase + field roundtable series proposal

Hi Mina / Marissa —

Hope you're both well. ModuWare recently shipped a native connector for Redwood's inference API and early customers are reporting strong latency wins in our integration tests. Our partnerships team would love to put together a joint program that pairs a short technical showcase webinar (30–40 minutes, demo-led) with a three-city field roundtable series for developer/engineering leaders (SF, NY, London).

High-level asks:
- Redwood to co-host a webinar in July (joint marketing, shared registration).
- 2–3 speaker slots across ModuWare/Redwood and a short customer panel (we can surface a reference).
- Shared MAP (mutual action plan) with promotional timelines and a draft speaker/ask matrix.
- ModuWare will fund venue + local logistics for the field roundtables; looking for Redwood marketing amplification and content co-ownership.

Attached a brief integration deck and a proposed MAP spreadsheet to kick things off — happy to iterate. James from DevSprint (copied) is our events producer and will help coordinate panels and local promotions.

Would you be open to a 30-minute sync this week to align scope and dates?

Best,
Ananya Rao
Head of Partnerships, ModuWare
ananya@moduware.io
+1 (415) 555-0124

Attachments:
- MODU-Redwood-integration-deck.pdf (pdf, 2.1MB)
- MODU-Redwood-MAP.xlsx (xlsx, 46KB)
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, James O'Connor <james@devsprint.co>
Date: Mon, 31 May 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Joint integration showcase + field roundtable series proposal

Ananya —

Thanks for the thoughtful proposal and for sharing the MAP + deck. This is the kind of joint program we prioritize for ISV integrations. Real quick: yes, interested. A few initial notes from our side so we can shape an agenda before we sync: 

- Target webinar date range: week of July 12 or July 19 (we have a backbone release July 8 so prefer after).
- Speaker mix: I suggest Redwood host the product lead + PM, ModuWare host the integration engineer, and we aim for one customer on the panel (ModuWare mentioned a reference — please confirm).
- KPIs: let's agree on registration target (2k), attendance (15–20%), and at least 150 MQLs across both activities.
- Marketing support: we'll provide email templates, a landing page, and paid social spend support (amount TBD once MAP is finalized).

Can James share three preferred dates for a 30-minute planning call? Also looping Karthik to help scope technical prep (runbook for demo reliability, stubbing out the demo data, etc.).

I'll review the MAP and drop inline comments. If everyone is comfortable, we can spin up a HubSpot deal and a DocuSign MOU for the joint program.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.com

All —

Love this. Quick practicals from Growth/Marketing: 

- Speaker ops: we can provide a 30-minute dry-run 3 business days before webinar; we'll need slide decks 72 hours prior.
- Creative/assets: ask ModuWare to share logos (SVG) and any customer logos with written permission; we'll produce a joint landing page and co-branded email templates.
- Paid support: Redwood can commit up to $4k of paid social for the webinar funnel (needs to be reserved in our July budget).
- Tracking: please include UTM params on all links; we'll add a HubSpot campaign and share attribution rules.

Security/compliance ask: Karthik, can you start the vendor security questionnaire? ModuWare included a short vendor questionnaire in the attachment — I want to make sure we can list a customer reference and that the connector aligns with our data handling guidance.

On scheduling: James — Wed Jun 2 at 11:00 ET works for me. Mina, can you confirm?

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
